# How-to

```{bash}
# Installation
# Delete the old combined env
mamba env remove -p /zfs/omics/projects/education/BBDA_transcriptomics/denovo/envs/transcriptomics_bbda

# Setup busco and transdecoder
mamba create \
   -p /zfs/omics/projects/education/BBDA_transcriptomics/denovo/envs/transcriptomics_bbda \
   -c bioconda -c conda-forge \
   busco=6.1.0 \
   transdecoder=6.0.0

# Work around a bioconda packaging bug in transdecoder=6.0.0: its build script
# was not updated for the new upstream layout, so the new `TransDecoder` wrapper
# never gets linked into bin/. The script itself is still installed under opt/,
# so link it in manually:
ln -s /zfs/omics/projects/education/BBDA_transcriptomics/denovo/envs/transcriptomics_bbda/opt/transdecoder/TransDecoder \
      /zfs/omics/projects/education/BBDA_transcriptomics/denovo/envs/transcriptomics_bbda/bin/TransDecoder

# Setup a separate env for trinity, since its heavy on dependencies
mamba create \
    -p /zfs/omics/projects/education/BBDA_transcriptomics/denovo/envs/trinity_bbda \
    -c bioconda -c conda-forge \
    trinity=2.15.2

# Add to environments
conda config --add envs_dirs /zfs/omics/projects/education/BBDA_transcriptomics/denovo/envs/

# Check permissions 
# (note, that I didn't have the permissions to do this change) 
ENV=/zfs/omics/projects/education/BBDA_transcriptomics/denovo/envs/transcriptomics_bbda
find "$ENV" -type f ! -perm -o=r | wc -l
find "$ENV" -type f ! -perm -o=r -exec chmod o+r {} +
find "$ENV" -type f ! -perm -o=r | wc -l   # expect 0
```
